title: Charama Shlokams
body:
Charama Shlokas 

In the Vedanta school of thought, three shlokas stand out as a guiding factor to the three philosophies of Dvaitha, Advaitha, and Visishta Advaitha. These three shlokas are referred to as charama shlokas.
The word charama in Sanskrit translates to ultimate or the total extreme. These shlokas are of such high regard as these were shlokas rendered by Lord Sriman Narayana in different situations but hold a fundamental and universal purpose. One can find three charama shlokas, namely, 

1) Varaha Charama Shlokam
2) Rama Charama Shlokam 
and 
3) Krishna Charama Shlokam. 

The three charama shlokas form the basis for the Sri Vaishnava school of thought as given to us by Sri Ramanujacharya.
